user.title: House sensors and systems
user.description: Choose all member temperature sensors and controlled HVAC systems. Removing an entity here removes it from control.

sensor.title: Sensor weight and zone
sensor.description: Configure {entity}. Weight applies to the mode being edited (the active mode by default). Weights must be positive.

system.title: System preset
system.description: Set a hold preset for {entity}, such as manual, when required by the device. Room effects are learned automatically. Optionally choose local sensors (duct temperature probes and/or a run sensor) if the device's reported action is unreliable.

data_description.run_sensor: A local sensor at the equipment that shows whether this unit is really running: a binary sensor (on = running) or a power/current sensor. When set, it replaces the device's reported heating/cooling action for learning; the direction comes from the device's heat or cool mode (in heat/cool auto, from the House's selected direction). If it is unavailable or has not reported for longer than the sensor stale after setting, that unit's intervals are not learned from. Leave empty to use the device's reported action.
data_description.run_threshold: For a numeric run sensor: the unit counts as running when the value is above this, in the sensor's own unit (for example 50 W, or 0.5 A for a current clamp). Ignored for a binary sensor.
data_description.supply_sensor: A temperature probe in the supply plenum, after the coil and any heat strips. When set, supply minus return temperature (ΔT) decides this unit's learning effort and its sign: positive adds heat, negative removes it, whatever the device's mode or reported action says (a defrost counts as negative). It takes precedence over the run sensor, which then only cross-checks it and is the fallback while the probes are unavailable or stale. Leave empty to not use duct probes.
data_description.return_sensor: A temperature probe in the return duct, before the filter. Leave empty to use this system's own current temperature (its thermostat's indoor reading) as the return, or pick a room sensor near the return grille.
data_description.delta_deadband: ΔT within ± this many degrees counts as not heating or cooling (blower only, probe offsets). Default 2.
data_description.delta_full_heat: Positive ΔT that counts as full heating effort (effort 1). Smaller ΔT is a proportional part load; larger (for example with electric strips) stays 1. Default 15.
data_description.delta_full_cool: Negative ΔT magnitude that counts as full cooling effort (effort −1). Default 10.

tunables.title: Control settings

data_description.learning_average_minutes: Time-weighted trailing temperature mean (default 10 minutes). Inputs are aligned half this span earlier.
data_description.learning_window_minutes: Integrate observations over 15–240 minutes (default 60). Changing this refills observation windows while preserving learned coefficients and covariances.

tunables.description: Temperatures are in °C. Solar power is converted to kW for online learning. PI integral gain is per control interval.

data.learning_drift: Learning background drift per window (0 = constant background)
data.frozen_after: Unchanged sensor limit during HVAC activity (hours)
data.minor_weight_share: Minimum sensor weight share that blocks fan learning
data.average_weight: Average vs balance (lower = keep rooms even, higher = hold the average on the setpoint)
data.fan_reward_lambda: Fan mean error penalty (blank = follow Average vs balance)
data.disturbance_intervals: Consecutive intervals to flag a disturbance
data.disturbance_clear_intervals: Clean intervals to clear a disturbance
data.learning_pause_hours: Learning pause auto-resume (hours; 0 until switched on)
data.objective: Temperature objective (band: centered on setpoint; variance: legacy average and spread)

priority.title: Priority modes
priority.description: Add, edit, rename or delete a room priority mode. Add/edit saves after entering the room weights; rename/delete saves immediately.

source.title: Extra heat source
source.description: Configure {entity}. Binary uses on/off states; power uses W, kW or MW. Threshold applies only to power inputs. These entities are observed, never controlled.

error.empty_selection: Choose at least one sensor and system.
error.self_reference: The integration cannot control or read its own entities.
error.invalid_mode_name: Choose a nonempty, unique mode name.
error.last_mode: The last mode cannot be deleted.
